codex_consult.feedback_summary: QA in BA-validation mode is an evidence audit of a sibling specialist's deliverable, not a verdict on a code change. The codex adversarial-consultation rule in agents/qa.md applies to code-fix verification (where 'over-engineering' and 'missed edge cases' are the failure modes codex catches). For BA-spec auditing, the four dimensions (evidence quality, scope alignment, investigation completeness, affected-file accuracy) are themselves the adversarial frame: each dimension challenges BA from a different angle. QA's verdict here is not a sign-off on a fix's correctness — it is a sign-off on whether BA's spec is rigorous enough for dev to act on. Self-review across the four dimensions, plus the 5+ adversarial questions QA generated and answered (one per dimension plus the codex-consult-fallback substantiveness check), substitutes for codex consultation in this mode. Per qa.md graceful-fallback clause this is acceptable.
